config.label: Your twitterapis
config.description: Your twitterapis.com API key. Create one at https://www.twitterapis.com/dashboard. Required: every tool call authenticates with it.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.twitterapis.com. Only set this if you were given a different endpoint.

config.label: Per-request timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it if you page through large follower lists on a slow link.
